title: Payment, Billing Hold and Coverage Update Limits: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
The Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) applies the same payment, hold and coverage-update limits to every patient class.

| Limit | Figure |
|---|---|
| Order in which an undesignated payment is applied across the patient's patient-due encounters | oldest service start date first |
| Largest single card payment accepted by phone or portal | 9999.99 USD |
| Calendar days after the first statement date within which newly reported insurance is billed (subject to the payer's timely-filing limit) | 365 |
| Calendar days of billing hold while newly reported coverage is verified | 30 |
| Billing holds an encounter may receive over its life | 2 |

## Points of reading

- *Card limit (hypothetical payments).* A card payment of 9999.99 is accepted; one of 10000.00 is not.
- *Payment order (hypothetical accounts).* Of two patient-due accounts, one with a service start date in March and one in June of the same year, an undesignated payment reaches the March account first.
- *Hold allowance.* An account that has already received 2 billing holds receives no third.
